messages.subject: Project Vertex - negotiation status
messages.plaintextBody:
Naomi,

Where we are: we've rejected Calbryn's attempt to widen their retained rights to outside oncology, which was the key risk. On money, we expect to land the upfront at £6.5m (they opened at £7.5m, we were at £6m). Liability cap likely 9 months; cure period 45 days. The Disclosure Letter is in hand - one item (a historic third-party enquiry on the combination patent) we're covering with a specific indemnity. I'll send v3 of the licence and the draft Disclosure Letter shortly. No change to the milestone or royalty structure.

Happy to talk it through.

Kind regards,
James
